answer: Before dawn the osier cutter wades into the bed with his billhook, choosing only rods that bend without snapping. Cane creel maker pannier seal is the choosing: a seal creel makers renew after creel shop hearings. The inlet is the first rod bent, the lotus the last before the bundle is tied, and the nectar is the tying, the withy pulled tight round the sheaf. A cheat would have to bend 17 sound rods and tie 17 honest bundles.
